data.long_meaning: The name Vikki is derived from the Greek word 'nikos' meaning victory. In the context of Christian spirituality, the name can represent triumph over challenges and adversity. The name Vikki carries the meaning “Victory” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Vikki usually hope their child will grow to embody victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vikki total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
